screening_reasoning: MLVI-CNN classifies six crop-stress-severity levels using vegetation indices plus a CNN (83.40% accuracy); a stress-classification task, not pixel-wise crop/weed segmentation.
A review/comparative study of computer-vision yield-prediction methods (CNNs, ViTs, object detectors) across the recent literature; survey without a primary UAV segmentation benchmark.

YOLO11 and RT-DETR perform bounding-box weed detection and localization of Poa annua in turfgrass from UAS imagery (F1 0.64, mAP@0.50 0.68); an object-detection task, not pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.

A general AI crop-health monitoring system compares CNN and Transformer classifiers for stress/disease/nutrient detection from drone, satellite, and IoT data; a classification/conceptual study without pixel-level segmentation.

Mask R-CNN performs pixel-level instance segmentation of Brassica oleracea (cabbage) heads in UAV imagery (COCO-format masks, mAP 98.6%); DL crop segmentation on UAV imagery with quantitative mask-accurary metrics.

MSU-Net performs semantic segmentation of buckwheat weeds from UAV multispectral imagery, reporting mIoU 0.65, Dice 0.85, F1 0.78 across band combinations; DL UAV crop/weed segmentation with explicit pixel-wise metrics.

A CNN image classifier (trained with OBIA-assisted labels) maps invasive Rumex obtusifolius in native grassland from UAV RGB (overall accuracy 93.8%); an image-classification approach in a non-crop grassland/pasture domain, not pixel-level segmentation.
AgroVision recommends crops from soil images and weather data using CNNs; a soil/weather-based crop-recommendation task, not a UAV crop/weed segmentation study.
A conceptual framework/review integrating AI, UAV, satellite, and IoT remote sensing for sustainable agriculture and environmental monitoring; survey without a primary segmentation benchmark.
A workshop poster on synthetic foreground augmentations for UAV weed detection with no abstract or quantitative results available; indexing-only entry.
A CNN identifies swollen-shoot disease from drone images of a cocoa plantation (98% accuracy); a tree-crop disease classification task outside the crop/weed pixel-segmentation scope.

A custom CNN reports weed-detection accuracy (94%) for site-specific rice herbicide application and is benchmarked against detection models (YOLOv5, ResNet50); a weed detection/classification study rather than a pixel-level segmentation benchmark.
A spatiotemporal paddy crop-yield-estimation study fusing multispectral imagery and climatic data; a yield-regression task with no abstract/quantitative detail available.

AgriFusionNet diagnoses plant diseases via multimodal classification on an EfficientNetV2-B4 backbone (94.3% classification accuracy, 28.5 ms); an image-classification task, not pixel-level crop/weed segmentation, despite edge-friendly metrics.
A systematic review of CNN architectures for weed detection and identification across 61 articles; survey without a primary segmentation benchmark.
A conceptual smart-farming system combining AI, ML, and IoT for irrigation/fertilizer/pest and crop-health advice; a high-level framework without a crop/weed segmentation benchmark.

ARS-DLConvNN uses CNNs and LSTMs on UAV hyperspectral/satellite data to assess crop stress, estimate yield, and detect disease; a crop-stress/yield monitoring framework rather than a crop/weed pixel-segmentation benchmark.

A GAN-based super-resolution method upscales low-resolution airborne RGB for precise weed detection; a super-resolution preprocessing + weed-detection study rather than a pixel-level segmentation benchmark.

A ViT weed-identification system deliberately uses ground-level mobile/camera RGB images and explicitly eliminates the need for a drone; a ground-level identification/classification study, not UAV crop segmentation.
An improved Faster R-CNN detects and counts sugarcane seedlings from UAV aerial photography (average accuracy 93.67%); a bounding-box detection/counting task, not pixel-level segmentation.
YOLOv11 is benchmarked for maize leaf-disease detection/classification across four classes (99.8% accuracy, 12 ms); a crop-disease detection/classification task, not pixel-level segmentation.
A PRISMA systematic review of AI applied to UAV aerial imagery for agronomic decision support (weeds, nutrition, water, pests, disease); survey without a primary segmentation benchmark.
A special-issue editorial overview of small-UAS sensor development and precision-agriculture/natural-resource applications; review/editorial content without a primary segmentation study.
A CNN detects coconut (Cocos nucifera) instances via bounding boxes in UAV imagery (95.33% average accuracy); a tree-crop/fruit object-detection task, not crop/weed pixel segmentation.

An extensive benchmark of eight object-detection models (YOLO, Faster R-CNN, RetinaNet, RT-DETR) for Palmer amaranth detection in soybean from UAS imagery; a bounding-box detection benchmark, not pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.
